title: .to_string() on string literals in test code (should be .to_owned())
description: ws/mod.rs test module and tests/client_tests.rs use .to_string() on string literals in multiple places: e.g. 'test'.to_string(), '@type'.to_string(), 'Request'.to_string(), 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:core'.to_string(), 'Mailbox/get'.to_string(), 'r1'.to_string(), etc. The idiomatic form for converting a &'static str literal to String is .to_owned() (documents intent: take ownership of this data). .to_string() invokes the Display trait, adding an unnecessary indirection. Clippy warn(clippy::str_to_string) catches these. Files: src/ws/mod.rs (test module, ~8 occurrences), tests/client_tests.rs (~10 occurrences).
